program: APPUI-01 - Detailed functional studies inside frozen Phase-1 architecture
question: Can Production Shaping / Current Possibility become implementation-usefully specific while remaining situation-first, preserving contextual/deep inspection, and avoiding ontology-first navigation or Product-open control invention?
inherited_law: Preferred path is Production -> current situation -> meaningful element -> contextual/deep inspection.
People Here, Relationships in Motion, Pressures Now, Open Questions and World Context may orient the current situation but do not become mandatory top-level silos.
Selection and keyboard focus remain distinct from fictional Director opportunity, relationship salience and Character agency.
Current/historical and provisional/effective meaning remain distinguishable.
Light and Dark are co-equal semantic presentations; the Stage baseline is untouched.

primary_hierarchy: Current Scene / current situation remains the primary creative frame.
Meaningful people, relationships, pressures, questions and world conditions are surfaced in relation to that situation.
Contextual inspection opens near the current situation after meaningful selection.
Deep object-oriented inspection/editing appears only after deliberate follow-through.
Whole-Production Character access and causal/history depth are available without silently changing current Scene membership or status.
design_result.selection_rule: keyboard focus may move without creating selection; selection is inspection state only and does not imply fictional attention or agency
design_result.current_possibility_rule: working creative frame only; no predictive or generated next-action authority is implied
design_result.history_rule: history is reached causally from meaningful current material and remains explicitly historical rather than becoming a global Archive mode
design_result.theme_parity: PASS - same hierarchy, disclosure and state meaning in Light/Dark
design_result.responsive_rule: orientation and inspector yield space before the current situation; narrow layouts use sequential primary surfaces with semantic return

mechanical_preflight.environment: Microsoft Edge Chromium CDP; exact self-contained HTML; no external resources

first_visual_pass_findings: The state panel named focus/selection as distinct but did not explicitly demonstrate that keyboard focus can move without selection.
The phrase current possibility could be misread as a predictive/generated recommendation surface unless bounded explicitly.
corrections: Added an explicit focus-independent witness to the no-selection state.
Added section law that current possibility is the creator's working frame and does not imply predictive/generated next-action authority.

non_authority: Exact orientation labels, navigation placement and commands remain provisional.
Final typography, palette, materials, icons and motion remain open.

Scene lifecycle, consequence review, Presentation Perspective switching, Take/Rehearsal/branching, transcript/timer/Pause, provider/model/cost, Performer assignment, portable Production, manuscript/export and specialized maps remain Product/Engineering gated.
No Stage visual successor or Phase-2 authority is created.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION - CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT
next: Detail the selected-entity contextual inspector and deep-inspection surface family inside the frozen shell, preserving semantic origin, disclosure, state distinctions and exact return behavior.
